messages:
maya: FYI the PR gate GH Actions run is leaving eval jobs in a weird state — job shows as 'in_progress' forever and the self-hosted runner pod doesn't terminate. Repro on PR #2488 :confused:

oliver: saw this earlier too. I canceled the run manually but the runner VM still had docker containers running. pasted logs: 
```
> 2026-03-19T21:12:03Z runner[pid=3472]: job 2488-evals started
> 2026-03-19T21:22:03Z runner[pid=3472]: job 2488-evals timed out waiting for matrix shards
> 2026-03-19T21:22:10Z runner[pid=3472]: attempted cancel but executor didn't respond
> 2026-03-19T21:22:40Z runner[pid=3472]: cleanup failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded
```

sasha: hmm, that rpc deadline bit matches the kubelet delete timeout we've seen in 2 other incidents. Are these runners using the new gha-evals-orchestrator service?

maya: yes, new orchestrator. It spawns ephemeral pods to run the eval harness per-matrix. The pods are annotated with `gha-evals=true` and label `pr=2488`.

rachel: quick repro steps I used: 
1) open PR with large eval matrix (~8 shards)
2) trigger PR gate
3) cancel the run from GH UI after ~5m
4) observe stale pods on the runner VM and GH run still shows in_progress 10+ minutes later

oliver: I checked `ps` on the runner VM: there are lingering `buildkite-agent` processes (old harness) and docker containers pinned to the evaluation image. `docker ps` shows: 
```
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE                          STATUS
c1a2b3       redwood/eval-runner:canary     Up 35 minutes
```

tom: could be that our GitHub Actions step for cancellation isn't propagating the SIGTERM into the orchestrator. Two common fixes: add `concurrency: \n  group: ${{ github.job }}-${{ github.ref }}\n  cancel-in-progress: true` at the workflow level, or ensure the runner's `post` cleanup calls the orchestrator's cancel endpoint.

maya: adding concurrency might help for duplicates, but doesn't fix a stuck pod when cancel issued. We need the orchestrator to accept cancellation callbacks and forcibly GC pods if they don't respond within Xs.

sasha: agreed. quick patch suggestion for the GHA job: add a step at the end that runs on `if: always()` to call the orchestrator cancel endpoint with run id. Example: 
```
- name: Notify orchestrator on exit
  if: always()
  run: |
    curl -fS -X POST $ORCH_URL/api/v1/runs/${{ github.run_id }}/cancel \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.ORCH_TOKEN }}"
```

rachel: can we also make the orchestrator mark runs as 'failed' if the runner VM reports executor unresponsive for >2m? Right now it waits indefinitely.

oliver: code pointer: `orchestrator/pkg/runner/handler.go` has `waitForExecutor()` which uses context timeout = 0 for PR gate path. I think we accidentally removed the timeout when switching to GRPC streaming. I'll open a tiny PR to restore a 90s deadline.

maya: nice. Also let's add a monitoring alert: count of pods with label `gha-evals=true` and pod age > 10m across runner nodes. Alert: `gha_evals_stale_pods > 0` should page oncall with run ids.

ci-bot: Scheduled nightly job created: `gha-evals-stale-pod-scan` runs at 03:15 UTC, will post results to #eng-ml/ci-alerts.

tom: for immediate mitigation, can someone run this on runner-3: 
```
kubectl get pods -A -l gha-evals=true -o wide | grep Running
kubectl delete pod <pod-name> --grace-period=30 --force
```

oliver: ran that, deleted 4 pods. I also restarted `runner-service` on the VM. After restart GH run updated to cancelled. Looks promising.

maya: thanks. Next steps: 
- oliver: PR to orchestrator to reinstate timeout + forced pod GC (ETA today)
- sasha: add `if: always()` cancel step in GH workflows and `concurrency: cancel-in-progress` (ETA tomorrow morning)
- rachel: add Prometheus alert rule and a quick dashboard panel for stale pods (ETA EOD)

rachel: can we include a short regression test in eval-harness CI that simulates a hung executor and checks orchestrator marks run failed? prevents silent regressions.

oliver: yep I'll add an integration test that mocks a non-responsive executor and asserts the 90s deadline path triggers GC.

maya: great. Thanks all. I'll update the PR description for the incident and link the runs. :thumbsup:
